tree_condition: log1p of three times conditional pair-displacement variance in Angstrom squared, replacing the existing second invariant edge channel; no additional parameters
training_objective: Squared physical-noise error in inverse tree covariance, normalized by3(N-1). Same scalar VP schedule, colored innovations with a tree held fixed per trajectory.
gaga_prior: alpha_T^2 * training_data_variance * P + sigma_T^2 * C_tree; fixed published truncation650, no new Gaussianity-optimality claim.
comparison: Only original baseline versus both-design extension; no target source-only or head-only evaluation arms. Use every fit and all attempts regardless of sign.
scope: Transfer of harmonic-mixture source design plus previously learned FM physical correction. Structured diffusion backbones are retrained from paired original random initializations; only physical-head weights transfer without retraining. The diffusion extension conditions the denoiser on a latent-tree covariance and uses this covariance throughout noising and reverse sampling; the original FM implementation is unchanged. Two archived baseline fits on the existing64-composition panel; no new evaluation-based hyperparameter selection. No H readout or quantum optimization.
primary: All-attempt joint yield, with per-fit gains and paired composition/crossed-fit confidence intervals; Bonferroni97.5percent intervals for the two target comparisons. Graph validity secondary; all outcomes retained.
